decisions.resolution: Warrant stages map to BOTH their respective prefix sections and the N.B.W. / B.W. section. R.C.C./S.C.C. cases map to R.C.C., S.C.C. and N.B.W. / B.W.
decisions.question: For an Unready case whose Next Purpose/Canonical Stage is N.B.W._Unready or B.W._Unready, should it always go to the N.B.W. / B.W. section regardless of case prefix, or should the case prefix rule continue to determine the section?

decisions.resolution: All Ready cases are routed unconditionally to the Hearing section.
decisions.question: If a case is marked Ready but its Next Purpose corresponds to a stage that appears only in the Unready sections of the final board (for example Steps or Reply/Say), where should that case be listed? (A) A specific existing Ready-side row? (B) The relevant Unready section despite the Ready flag? (C) A new Ready-side row? (D) Another rule applies?
